The Vision

TimeWize is a productivity engine that bridges the gap between structured time management and the engaging feedback loops of gaming. By transforming task completion into an achievement-based journey, it helps users maintain long-term focus and consistency.

Smart Tracking

Precision timers with background execution and automated manual adjustments.

Gamification

Unlockable badges and streak logic that incentivizes daily productivity habits.

Analytics

Deep insights into time distribution across projects with beautiful chart visualizations.
